title: Prometheus: scraping, PromQL, exporters and Alertmanager

videos.script: Every service of the shop keeps a few counters, and publishes them at one address. Nobody sends them anywhere. {{counters}} Every fifteen seconds, Prometheus comes and asks. That one decision, pull instead of push, shapes everything in this lesson. {{pull}} You list what Prometheus is asking, and whether each target answered. You write your first queries: which series, how fast they grow, what share of them are errors. {{queries}} You meet the exporters, small programs that translate a machine, a database and an outside probe into the same format. And the one job that cannot be asked, because it is gone before the next scrape. {{exporters}} Then you break payments, one charge in twenty, and follow an alert from a rule, through two minutes of waiting, to a page. {{alert}}
